coverLetter: I'm excited to apply for the Backend Developer (Laravel) position at The Big Phone Store. With 7+ years of experience building scalable backend systems in Laravel and PHP, I bring hands-on expertise across your entire stack—from Laravel APIs and database optimization to Vue.js frontend collaboration and Redis/Elasticsearch integrations.

At BSE America, I architected an end-to-end CRM with WooCommerce integration, building RESTful APIs for automated invoicing and payment processing in a remote setting. I implemented Redis caching and PostgreSQL optimizations that reduced API response times by 35%, directly improving eCommerce checkout performance. During my time at First Due, I developed multi-tenant SaaS features serving 40+ enterprise clients using PHP and Vue.js, handling 5,000+ daily transactions with robust background job processing.

Your tech stack aligns perfectly with my experience: Laravel (8.4/10+), PHP (7.4+), Vue.js/Nuxt.js, Redis, and Elasticsearch. I'm particularly drawn to your mission around sustainability in tech, and I appreciate your remote-first culture with visa sponsorship pathways. Having worked remotely with teams across the US, Spain, and Panama, I thrive in autonomous, results-driven environments.

I'm passionate about writing clean, maintainable code and continuously improving system architecture. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to The Big Phone Store's platform and help scale your eCommerce operations while growing with your team.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my Laravel expertise can support your technical goals.
